reportHeadline: Bright start not enough as Town
reportIntro: Bollington Town took an early lead at Ruskin Sports Village through Mouhamadou Bamba Seye and were good value for it in a strong first half, but St Helens Town levelled shortly after the break, controlled much of the second half and struck again in the closing minutes to take the points.

firstHalfEvents.title: Goal — Mouhamadou Bamba Seye
firstHalfEvents.description: Town made a flying start. A slick passing move ended with **Xavi Llorente** picking out **Mouhamadou Bamba Seye**, who finished to put Bollington ahead. 0-1.

firstHalfEvents.title: Town Push for a Second
firstHalfEvents.description: Bollington carried the momentum through the half and created several good openings to extend the lead.

firstHalfEvents.title: Solid at the Back
firstHalfEvents.description: When St Helens did come forward, Town's back line and **Matthew Joyce** stood firm to take a deserved lead into the break.

secondHalfEvents.title: St Helens Level
secondHalfEvents.description: The hosts came out strongly after the restart and drew level shortly after half time. 1-1.

secondHalfEvents.title: St Helens Take Control
secondHalfEvents.description: St Helens dominated possession for long spells as Town worked hard to hold their shape.

secondHalfEvents.title: Late Winner for the Hosts
secondHalfEvents.description: St Helens found the decisive goal in the final minutes to edge the game. 2-1.

pullQuote: A strong first-half display deserved more, but St Helens' second-half pressure told in the closing minutes.
matchVerdict: Bollington Town started brightly at Ruskin Sports Village and took an early lead after a good team move, **Xavi Llorente** setting up **Mouhamadou Bamba Seye** to finish. Town were the stronger side in the first half, creating a few good chances and defending well to go in ahead.
St Helens Town came out strongly after the break and equalised shortly after half time. The hosts enjoyed most of the ball from there and found a late winner in the final minutes.
A frustrating end to the afternoon after an excellent first-half performance, but plenty of positives to build on.
